The 3–0 scoreline I predicted assumed a level of clinical finishing from Seleção das Quinas that, frankly, they have never reliably delivered in tournament football, and I should have discounted that more aggressively. One draw is not a disaster for group-stage progress, but my pre-match model was badly calibrated on Léopards' threat.
